text:
deploybot: :rotating_light: Canary alert for release embed-prod:v2.1.7 — canary group 3 reporting sustained 5xx (avg ~18% over 5m). Blocking rollout. Rollout ID r-2026-03-21-6367. Please advise: rollback to v2.1.6, pin traffic, or allow rollforward.

alex: oncall here, seeing tokenizer timeouts in the canary logs. stack traces point to `tokenizer.decode()` spikes, CPU hotspots on nvidia0. Noticed same pattern in a small staging shard earlier.

maria: agree we should rollback to v2.1.6 until we root-cause. Can we pin at the LB layer to avoid a full flip? @ops-lee can you run expedited rollback if release-cx signs off? :thumbsup:

ops-lee: I can execute rollback now. Need confirmation from release-cx. If approved I'll run the sequence and post audit links.

release-cx: expedited approval granted for rollback to v2.1.6. We should capture notes for the postmortem and notify infra-cust. :white_check_mark:

sre-jordan: recommended procedure: drain canary pods then rollback to avoid in-flight errors. Proposed commands: 
```
# drain canary pods
kubectl scale deploy/embed-prod-canary -n prod --replicas=0
# rollback to known-good revision (v2.1.6 -> revision 145)
kubectl rollout undo deploy/embed-prod -n prod --to-revision=145
kubectl rollout status deploy/embed-prod -n prod
```

alex: confirmed revision 145 == v2.1.6. I'll mute noisy alerts for the window and watch traces while you run it.

ops-lee: executing now: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-prod-canary -n prod --replicas=0` -> scaling. Starting rollout undo to rev 145. Posting CI link once done.

deploybot: deploybot: Rollout undo started (r-2026-03-21-6367 -> undo rev 145). CI webhook: https://ci.internal/r-2026-03-21-6367/rollback

maria: will run a 15m canary smoke on v2.1.6 once pods are stable; verifying end-to-end embed latency and error rates.

ops-lee: rollback complete. `kubectl get pods -n prod` shows all embed-prod pods at v2.1.6, 10/10 ready. Posting audit: https://audit.internal/ops/6367890123/rollback

sre-jordan: monitoring shows 5xx back to baseline, suspending related alert for 10m to avoid noise. Keep an eye on tokenization traces.

alex: opening issue to add a pre-merge perf test for tokenizer path and a config guard to catch this regression. Ticket: RFC-2026-88.

maria: linked RFC and raised follow-up for kernel/quant tuning in the release backlog.

deploybot: deploybot: Rollout status: rollback complete, rollout blocked cleared. Thread closed by ops-lee.
